text:
Anya: Heads up — our biweekly release train currently lands on Tue next week which overlaps with the UK bank holiday. Can we move the slot + confirm bridge and changelog owner?
Mike: Which slot/time is that today?
Anya: Current slot is Tue 2029-07-10 16:00 UTC. Proposal: move to Wed 2029-07-11 14:00 UTC so EU folks aren't on a holiday.
Tessa: I can cover bridge on Wed 14:00 UTC. :raising_hand:
Sanjeev: I can handle cherry-picks and ping reviewers once the slot is moved. Will need a changelog PR title from someone.
Mike: SGTM. I'll update the release-train calendar and send a quick PR to update the changelog. Suggested PR title: `chore(changelog): bump to 0.12.1 (train 2029-07-11)`
Rafael: Quick check — any late RCs depending on Tue cutoff? If yes we should keep Tue for them.
Anya: Good call. I checked: only #core-infra had a small tweak but it can be cherry-picked. Cutoff policy still applies: no new changes <6h before deploy.
Sanjeev: Noted. I'll run the cherry-picks after Mike's PR lands and tag reviewers: @Tessa @Rafael.
Tessa: ping me when the PR is up, I'll do a quick changelog review.
Mike: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/changelog/pulls/234 — title as above. Also updated calendar event to Wed 2029-07-11 14:00 UTC and added `eng-release-bridge` as required attendee.
deploy-bot: :calendar: release-scheduler: rescheduled train slot to 2029-07-11T14:00:00Z (id: rt-2029-07-11-14). Pipeline reservation created.
Rafael: I'll scan for conflicts today and post here if any blockers.
Anya: Thanks — if no blockers by EOD UTC tomorrow we lock the move. Also reminder to owners: cutoff = 6h before deploy (so 08:00 UTC Wed).
Sanjeev: Copy that. Quick snippet I'll run for cherry-picks:```bash
git checkout -b cherry/0.12.1-<pr>
git cherry-pick <commit-hash>
git push origin HEAD
```
Tessa: Perfect. Can we also add a note in the bridge runbook about the holiday backup contact (Emily)? Small change but saves confusion.
Mike: Added a line in the runbook and pinged Emily to confirm availability.
Anya: Awesome. If anything changes, flag here — otherwise locking Wed 14:00 UTC after Rafael's scan. :white_check_mark:
